With None, assembly and solves run in one vmap with the same operations and order as the parent. The only differences are that the frequency-independent detector-selection preparation is computed once up front and the carrier connector gather happens before the broadcast multiply. Candidate 4 (3206ea9f, loop around solves only) passed the official check and failed strict. Its gradient was bit-identical to candidates 2 and 3. It also lost most of the gain: first run 23.546 s, forward 10.31 s, gradient 1.80 s, RSS 11.7 GB, warm median 12.21 s. So the strict drift comes from the solve and noise-contraction path whenever it runs inside a scan, regardless of chunk size or loop scope. Most of the reverse-pass and memory savings come from running assembly per frequency. Nothing was run locally.
